title: The Postcard of the Old Mill House
author: Sable Eastwick
blurb: Lena Crane, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
